Run this entire Rnotebook to perform background subtraction & scoring from sample pairs for treated vs. untreated followed by thresholding and extraction for 'hits'.


LIBRARIES
```{r}
source("./_resources/basicFunctions_v2.R")

```


MAIN ACTION
```{r}
#
# LOAD generic blacklists for both ENCODE & CUT&RUN

# file locations
file_blacklist_cr <- "./_resources/blacklist/13059_2023_3027_MOESM2_ESM_hg38.csv"
file_blacklist_encode <- "./_resources/blacklist/ENCFF356LFX.bed.gz"

# make GRanges of blacklist
gr_blacklist_cr <- vroom(file = file_blacklist_cr) %>% makeGRangesFromDataFrame(
  keep.extra.columns = TRUE,
  ignore.strand = TRUE,
  seqnames.field = "chr",
  start.field = "start",
  end.field = "end"
)

gr_blacklist_encode <- vroom(file = file_blacklist_encode,col_names = c("seqname", "start", "end")) %>% makeGRangesFromDataFrame(
  keep.extra.columns = TRUE,
  ignore.strand = TRUE,
  seqnames.field = "seqname",
  start.field = "start",
  end.field = "end"
)

# merge & reduce into final blacklist
gr_blacklist_merged <- c(gr_blacklist_cr, gr_blacklist_encode) %>% GenomicRanges::reduce()


#
# COMPUTE SITE SCORES, FILTER, AND OUTPUT

# params
manifest <- vroom(file = "./_step2_getHits/manifest.csv")
input_dir <- "./_step1_precompute/_output/"
output_dir <- "./_step2_getHits/_output/"

# get filtered hits & save results
purrr::pmap(
  .l = manifest,
  .f = ~ do_analysis(
    file_background_rds = ..1,
    file_sample_rds = ..2,
    guide_seq = ..3,
    gr_blacklist = gr_blacklist_merged,
    input_dir = input_dir,
    output_dir = output_dir,
    score_threshold = 30,
    CT_filter = TRUE
  )
)



#
# MAKE SUMMARY DNA SEQUENCE LOGOS

# get filenames
list_files <- list.files(path = output_dir, pattern = "*.csv", full.names = TRUE)
list_files

# main action
for (i in 1:length(list_files)) {
  # load data
  tb_data <- vroom(list_files[i], col_names = TRUE)
  
  #
  # MAKE ggseqlogo w/ 'bits' scaling
  gg_seqlogo <- ggseqlogo(
    data = toupper(tb_data$target_seq),
    method = 'bits',
    seq_type = "dna"
  )
  
  
  # save output
  outputFile <- paste0(output_dir, basename(list_files[i]), "_bits_n", nrow(tb_data))
  
  outputFile_plot <- paste0(outputFile, ".pdf")
  ggsave(
    filename = outputFile_plot,
    plot = gg_seqlogo,
    device = "pdf",
    width = 6,
    height = 2
  )
}

```
